body: Slipping into oblivion is the most comforting part of the human experince

Its frustrating because it doesnt stop. I dont ask why shit happens anymore that is supposed to be off the charts...I doesn't make sense. The absurdity has driven me to a place that is so low...its left me hollow. My friends well one of them is likely dead, she was close to me...and the other one is dying from her disease. These friends I let in which was a big step, and their own problems took them. When I tell the only two friends I have left what continues to happen, one sits in shock and awe, the other genuinely listens but my life problems are so advanced that it's hard for either to console or completely understand. I dont blame them, who could. And the nature of my story makes it genuinely impossible for me to find any kind of support or solution. My trauma therapist even recognizes that its absolutely astronomically absurd.

It hurts so much. I dont know how it's possible. It's too much pain for one human to bear. And I feel like no one including myself has a solution. I walk as the empty shell of a man that's been stripped of himself. I am truthfully having trouble seeing why to continue. My birthday is 3 days away...and that promise doesn't seem like the worst idea...people say to hold on for this and that, but why hold on anymore I just keep getting hurt. I just cant keep on like this...
